audience: teams that convert office files, PDFs and images from a public link

useCases.title: Convert a file to another format
useCases.text: Read the options of a conversion, such as PDF to DOCX, then convert a file from a public https link. Each conversion uses quota.

useCases.title: Find the formats a conversion accepts
useCases.text: Describe one conversion with its accepted source and target formats and its parameter names.

useCases.title: Check the conversion quota
useCases.text: Read the account status, the total quota, the conversions used and the conversions left.

useCases.title: Report conversions per day
useCases.text: Read the conversions per day between two dates, to report usage over a period.
